notes.title: The Story Behind Shadow Dash: Oldschool Arcade Experience
notes.content:
Fred explains how Shadow Dash aims to reproduce some of the old-school arcade experiences one may have experienced. A mix between amazing graphics and retro gaming.

[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@thisisradar/video/7440831115486694688?is_from_webapp=1&sender_device=pc&web_id=7328832786298062369]Take a look at the story on TikTok![/url]

notes.title: Check out the Shadow Dash Demo!
notes.content:
The demo for Shadow Dash is now available for free! 
Not sure if the game is for you just yet? Try out the demo and find out! 

We are also looking for any feedback you may have regarding controls and gameplay. What else would you like to see in future levels? 

[b]Download the demo[/b] now and [b]wishlist Shadow Dash[/b] to be notified of any updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3194650/Shadow_Dash/
